scope: Production ARM64 deque, callable, owner allocation and complete NRO code with independent sequence/lifetime models. OS, RO, filesystem and outer game scheduling remain modeled. Three exact probes run locally; no new physical acceptance or frame-time claim.
acceptance_limits: Owner-thread exception-free types; mutations, calls, moves and destruction must not yield or reenter an active mutation/invocation
Function supports void signatures, explicit cloning and inline/owner-heap targets; it is not hosted std::function
Deque is ring storage with explicit At access and fallible operations; it is not standard-container ABI
Growth, copying and cleanup remain synchronous and may require temporary overlapping allocation
Captured borrows retain caller-managed lifetimes; cancellation destroys pending actions without invoking or rolling back completed actions
The unchanged pending kernel and all three probes need one combined physical Batch 8 acceptance
Physical stack/RAM, frame time, fragmentation, low memory, transitions and extended sessions remain open
Global constructors, static-local policy, exceptions, hosted STL and full Menyoo compatibility remain separate work
